title: Q-Point Memory Link
description: A schema for linking Q-Point records to Memory Weight Records and determining integrated memory weight.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Q-Point Memory Link record.

q_point_id.description: Identifier of the linked Q-Point record.

memory_record_id.description: Identifier of the linked Memory Weight Record.

version.description: Optional version of this link record or integration model.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the Q-Point Memory Link.

origin_strength.description: Score measuring the strength of the question origin.

question_depth.description: Score measuring the depth of the question.

tension_score.description: Score measuring structural tension or problem pressure.

resonance_score.description: Score measuring resonance across contexts, systems, or users.

risk_sensitivity.description: Score measuring safety, governance, misuse, or review sensitivity.

score_formula.description: Optional formula or formula version used to compute q_point_memory_score.

original_memory_weight_score.description: Original Memory Weight score before Q-Point integration.

q_point_memory_score_weight.description: Weight assigned to q_point_memory_score in the integrated formula.

memory_weight_score_weight.description: Weight assigned to original_memory_weight_score in the integrated formula.

integrated_memory_weight_score.description: Final integrated score after combining Memory Weight and Q-Point scores.

final_weight.description: Final memory weight after Q-Point integration.

final_layer.description: Final memory layer after Q-Point integration.

core_type.description: Core Memory subtype. Required when final_layer is core_memory.

previous_weight.description: Optional previous memory weight before integration.

previous_layer.description: Optional previous memory layer before integration.

action.description: Decision produced by the Q-Point Memory Weight integration.

review_required.description: Whether human or governance review is required.

override_applied.description: Whether a Q-Point override rule was applied.

trace_required.description: Whether a Trace record is required.

promotion_reason_required.description: Whether a promotion reason must be recorded.

q_point_id_required.description: Whether the Q-Point identifier is required for this decision.

trace_ref.description: Optional reference path or URI to the Trace record.

royalty_relevant.description: Whether this link may become relevant to Royalty OS or value return.

origin_attribution_required.description: Whether origin attribution should be preserved for future value routing.

return_route_ref.description: Optional reference to a return route or royalty record.

links.description: Optional related links to documents, records, protocols, or repositories.
